tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Integration & Global Technology
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your global technology team to contribute to complex enterprise platform integrations. With over 5 years of specialized experience building and scaling large e-commerce architectures at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in API design, backend development, and cross-system data synchronization.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized complex data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to ensure seamless product catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: API & OMS Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed robust OCC REST Web Services and managed Order Management (OMS) workflows for enterprise platforms.

bullets.label: ERP & Backend Alignment
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce platforms, collaborating closely with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Delivery & Collaboration
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 and worked in techno-functional capacities to bridge business requirements with technical execution.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start immediately thereafter. I look forward to discussing how my integration and backend expertise can support your global technology initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and integration experience to your global technology team. Having delivered robust API architectures, ERP data pipelines, and OMS solutions for industry leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about contributing to your scalable platform ecosystems and collaborating with international engineering teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving scalable enterprise integrations and backend architectures for global technology platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce integration and backend experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'd love to connect regarding your global technology team openings. I bring deep expertise in APIs, ERP data pipelines, and OMS. Based in Germany and available from December 16, 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application - Integration & Enterprise Platforms - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your global technology team. With over 5 years of enterprise-level experience designing backend architectures, API integrations, and data pipelines for platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your complex system integrations.

My complete CV, certifications, and cover letter are attached for your review. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and available starting December 16, 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
